sources.confirmed: Operator, via the project owner: the city 24pay ticket is valid 50 minutes, the Arcuș one 60 minutes and costs more.
sources.tariff_page: https://multitrans.ro/tarife.html — dated 01.02.2026 but OUT OF DATE: it still prints 45 minutes for the city ticket. Prices and passes below are taken from it and have not been re-confirmed.
sources.arcus: Multi-Trans announcement: the 24pay ticket now covers the Arcuș services, 4 lei / 60 minutes.

note: Arcuș is a separate commune, so line 10 crosses a fare boundary. Validity comes from the operator directly; the prices still come from the tariff page, which was wrong about the validity and may be stale about the amounts too. Șugaș Băi is treated as city because the resort belongs to Sfântu Gheorghe, unconfirmed.
